updates.title: How to make existing-customer revenue predictable
updates.blurb: A new page answers a question sales already solved for new logos: how do you forecast the revenue you already have? Put it in a pipeline, manage the customer progression that moves it, and let confirmed outcomes update probability and sharpen the forecast.

updates.title: The conclusion now ties plays to the forecast
updates.blurb: The closing chapter's loop passage now spells out how play outcomes update the pipeline, the pipeline updates probability, and probability improves the forecast, making existing-customer revenue predictable the way new-logo revenue is.

updates.title: See what retention is worth
updates.blurb: The ROI Calculator turns retention into dollars. Plug in your ARR, growth goal, and NRR, and it shows what a strong post-sale motion is actually worth — faster year-one growth, a far lighter new-sales quota, lower cost of churn, and a bigger number at exit. Run it against your own numbers.

updates.title: Ask questions and share results, right here
updates.blurb: The Reader Hub now takes your questions and field results directly. Ask about any play or stage and I'll reply, and tell me what happened when you ran something so it can shape the next edition.
